description: This file defines Flask API routes, schemas, and resources for managing test runs, including creating, retrieving, and fetching logs for test runs.

classes.name: TestRunBaseSchema
classes.description: Schema for base test run data, including optional test_case_id and metadata.

classes.name: TestRunCreateSchema
classes.description: Schema for creating a new test run, inherits from TestRunBaseSchema.

classes.name: TestRunSchema
classes.description: Schema representing a complete test run, including id, status, timestamps, logs, and results.

classes.name: LogsQuerySchema
classes.description: Schema for querying logs with pagination and full retrieval options.

classes.name: LogsResponseSchema
classes.description: Schema for the response containing logs, total count, offset, and limit.

classes.name: TestRunListResource
classes.description: API resource for listing all test runs and creating new test runs.

classes.name: TestRunResource
classes.description: API resource for retrieving a specific test run by ID.

classes.name: TestRunLogsResource
classes.description: API resource for retrieving logs of a specific test run with pagination.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Handles GET requests for listing test runs, fetching a specific test run, or logs, depending on the resource.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create and enqueue a new test run.
